First National Trust Co Upped Its Oracle (ORCL) Holding; Pyxis Tankers (PXS) Shorts Increased By 4.89%
May 4, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
First National Trust Co increased Oracle Corp (ORCL) stake by 48.26% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. First National Trust Co acquired 37,446 shares as Oracle Corp (ORCL)’s stock declined 4.18%. The First National Trust Co holds 115,035 shares with $5.44M value, up from 77,589 last quarter. Oracle Corp now has $183.95 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.99% or $0.45 $45.06. About 15.37 million shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 1.20% uptrending. 10.35% the S&P500.
Pyxis Tankers Inc (NASDAQ:PXS) had an increase of 4.89% in short interest. PXS’s SI was 470,100 shares in May as released by FINRA. Its up 4.89% from 448,200 shares previously. With 79,700 avg volume, 6 days are for Pyxis Tankers Inc (NASDAQ:PXS)’s short sellers to cover PXS’s short positions. The SI to Pyxis Tankers Inc’s float is 12.28%. The stock decreased 0.91% or $0.01 $1.09. About 20,619 shares traded. Pyxis Tankers Inc. (NASDAQ:PXS) has declined 55.41% downtrending. 66.96% the S&P500.
Pyxis Tankers Inc. operates as a maritime transportation firm with a focus on the tanker sector in the United States. The company has market cap of $22.76 million. The Company’s fleet transports refined petroleum products, such as naphtha, gasoline, jet fuel, kerosene, diesel, and fuel oil, as well as other liquid bulk items, including vegetable oils and organic chemicals. It currently has negative earnings. As of March 24, 2017, the firm operated a fleet of six double hull product tankers.
First National Trust Co decreased Cvs Health Corp (NYSE:CVS) stake by 6,204 shares to 17,270 valued at $1.25 million in 2017Q4. It also reduced Vanguard Index Fds (VNQ) stake by 4,353 shares and now owns 28,864 shares. Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) was reduced too.
